{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm since the estimand depends on it
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
species_highest_mean = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
mean_flipper_highest = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f'Species with highest mean flipper length: {species_highest_mean}')
print(f'Mean flipper length: {mean_flipper_highest:.2f} mm')
print('\nMean flipper lengths by species:\n', mean_flipper_by_species)"}
